title: Gane's Distance, at Home
sub: Monday to Friday. Inspired by Ciryl Gane's style, not his exact program.
note: Gane never stands in front of you: a small step to the side after every exchange, a long jab and teep from the edge of range, and the counter when you commit to a big shot. He came from Muay Thai, and it shows in his feet.

items: From your stance, step off to the side and turn to face the new line. Feet never cross, never together.
Jab, then step to the side before you'd get hit back. Never two jabs from the same spot.
Touch the target at full reach, then step back out of range.
Lift the knee, push through the heel, put the foot back in your stance. Switch legs every round.
Jab to bring the hands up, teep to the stomach, step back.
Picture a big right hand. Step off the line, fire a cross as it misses.
Lean out of range on the back foot, jab straight back in.
Pivot on the lead foot, finish off to the side. Switch sides every round.
Light on the balls of your feet.
Small quick steps in every direction, hands up.
Jab, teep, step off. Every time you picture them committing, step off and counter.
